question: Nearly ______ countries of the world are currently members of the WTO. (as on June 2014)
solution:
The correct answer is __**160.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **160 countries** of the world are currently members of the WTO as of **June 2014.**
 
• The WTO (World Trade Organization) is an intergovernmental organization that regulates** international trade** between nations.
 
• It was established in **1995** and is headquartered in **Geneva, Switzerland.**
 
• The WTO provides a forum for member countries to negotiate and enforce **trade agreements, resolve disputes,** and** promote free trade.​**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• According to the **1994 Marrakesh Agreement**, the **World Trade Organization** (WTO) formally began operations on **January 1, 1995,** taking the place of the **General Agreement on Tariffs and Trade** (GATT), which had been founded in **1948. **
 
• The WTO is the** largest international economic organization** in the world, with **164 member states** that today account for more than** 98% of trade and GDP worldwide.**
 
• Members of the WTO contribute around** USD 220 million** annually toward the organization's budget, which is determined by their share of global commerce.
